description.value: Temaki Sushi is a sushi restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, operating since 2003. The restaurant offers three seating styles — standard tables, a sushi bar, and a communal shared table — along with a full takeout and catering menu. They describe their approach as 'sushi reimagined,' with a focus on consistent quality and evolving flavours.
